name: Safety Rotate Fire Zone
formation: 11P Gun Slot Right vs Two-High Disguise Shell

summary.motive: Show a static Cover 2 shell to bait quick-game answers, then rotate to single-high Cover 3 fire zone coverage behind five-man pressure.
summary.keyDefender: Strong safety executing the downhill rotation
summary.whyItWorks: Quick-game timing assumes two-deep help; when the shell rotates and an extra dog comes, the QB is squeezed between a disappearing window and a free blitzer.
summary.failureMode: The offense tags a hot throw to the boundary flat before the rotation finishes, hitting the void left by the rolling safety.

beats.title: 1. The Cover 2 Illusion
beats.text: Both safeties split the field at nine-plus yards and both corners press, painting a textbook two-deep shell that invites the quick slant-flat game.

beats.title: 2. The Rotation Trigger
beats.text: At the snap the strong safety sprints downhill while the free safety backpedals to the post and both corners flip their hips into a three-deep bail.

beats.title: 3. The Five-Man Surge
beats.text: With four linemen charging plus the WILL dogging the weak A-gap, the running back is caught scanning the wrong side and the interior gives way.

beats.title: 4. Hit in the Rotation Window
beats.text: The QB hesitates between his crosser and comeback, and the unblocked WILL arrives exactly in the gap created by the safety rotation.

relations.tell: Both safeties start at equal nine-yard depths like true Cover 2 halves; the tell is the strong safety leaning forward in his pedal at the snap instead of backpedaling.
